description: This file defines the 'Generator' class responsible for generating HTML content within a documentation static site generator. It manages content types, directory setup, page generation, and integration with templates and content handlers.

classes.name: Generator
classes.description: A class for generating HTML documentation pages from source content, supporting configuration, content types, and templating.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the generator with a Daux instance and sets up the template renderer.

methods.name: getContentTypes
methods.description: Returns available content types, currently only 'markdown'.

methods.name: generateAll
methods.description: Generates the entire set of documentation pages, handling directory cleanup, content generation, and output file writing.
